primary_source.title: A hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin method for both thin and 3D nonlinear elastic structures
primary_source.authors: S. Terrana; N. C. Nguyen; J. Bonet; J. Peraire
primary_source.checked_scope: Published author PDF: sections 2.2 through 3.3, equations 3-18, approximation spaces, four-field variational principle, common volume/trace traction, and stabilization discussion.
primary_source.publisher_access: Publisher open attempt returned 403; author-hosted PDF and university repository were available.
primary_source.independent_extension: ANCF Q4 x thickness-P2 volume, independent vertical-face position traces with top/bottom trace tied to volume position, S4 or S3+ mixed gradient spaces, fixed reference linear-limit tau=2.5 and Lc=.5. Original adaptive stabilization and full 3D equal-order method are not reproduced.

method_scope: New mixed volume/trace verification candidate; not product adoption or a general HDG rejection
